list.name: run_batch
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT run_batch FROM benchmark_metrics.musique_completeness ORDER BY run_batch

targets.rawSql: SELECT arm_name, avg(evidence_recall) AS evidence_recall FROM benchmark_metrics.musique_completeness WHERE run_batch = '$run_batch' GROUP BY arm_name ORDER BY evidence_recall DESC
SELECT arm_name, avg(complete_evidence_coverage) AS complete_coverage FROM benchmark_metrics.musique_completeness WHERE run_batch = '$run_batch' GROUP BY arm_name ORDER BY complete_coverage DESC
SELECT avg(answer_f1) AS answer_f1, avg(exact_match) AS exact_match FROM benchmark_metrics.musique_completeness WHERE run_batch = '$run_batch' AND answer_f1 IS NOT NULL
SELECT hops::text AS hops, arm_name, avg(evidence_recall) AS recall FROM benchmark_metrics.musique_completeness WHERE run_batch = '$run_batch' GROUP BY hops, arm_name ORDER BY hops, arm_name

SELECT hops::text AS hops, arm_name, avg(complete_evidence_coverage) AS coverage FROM benchmark_metrics.musique_completeness WHERE run_batch = '$run_batch' GROUP BY hops, arm_name ORDER BY hops, arm_name

SELECT arm_name, count(*) AS runs, round(avg(evidence_recall)::numeric, 3) AS recall, round(avg(complete_evidence_coverage)::numeric, 3) AS coverage, round(avg(retrieved_count)::numeric, 1) AS retrieved, round(avg(model_calls)::numeric, 1) AS model_calls, round(avg(total_tokens)::numeric, 0) AS tokens_per_case, round(avg(latency_ms)::numeric, 0) AS latency_ms FROM benchmark_metrics.musique_completeness WHERE run_batch = '$run_batch' GROUP BY arm_name ORDER BY coverage DESC

SELECT task_id, hops, evidence_recall, complete_evidence_coverage, answer_f1, stop_reason FROM benchmark_metrics.musique_completeness WHERE run_batch = '$run_batch' AND arm_name = 'musique_graph_rlm' ORDER BY evidence_recall ASC, task_id LIMIT 30
